dedupe_keys.name: portail de l assainissement collectif stations de traitement des eaux usees roseau eru database france

description: The French collective sanitation portal publishes the national database of urban wastewater systems (the ERU database, filled in by the water police services through the ROSEAU application) for metropolitan France and the overseas departments. The Ministry of Ecological Transition's water and biodiversity directorate runs it to report on compliance of treatment plants and collection systems with the Urban Waste Water Directive and national rules. Exports list each wastewater treatment plant and its agglomeration with capacity, size band, location by basin, region and department, and compliance for equipment, performance and dry-weather collection, for data years 2015 to 2024; further exports cover storm overflows and spread sewage sludge. Data can be downloaded free as pipe-delimited CSV or GeoJSON, or read through SANDRE WFS and WMS services (layer sa:SysTraitementEauxUsees). Licence: site texts are under Etalab Open Licence 2.0, and reuse of the data is subject to the portal's legal notice. Caveats: the ministry warns that some information is still being acquired, plants in agglomerations under 2,000 population equivalent are much less reliable, and indicators changed in 2023 from national to full regulatory compliance, so series are not directly comparable. Simulation uses: siting and sizing treatment assets, linking plants to catchments and flood hazards, and sewer network and capacity models. Related records: the European UWWTD treatment plant data (data-uwwtd-treatment-plants), HydroWASTE (data-hydrowaste) and England's storm overflow returns (data-ea-edm-storm-overflows-annual-returns).
